text: This report initiates the Mount Dennis Zoning By-law and Urban Design Guidelines Study and summarizes the study scope, process and timing. The purpose of the Study is to develop a new zoning by-law and urban design guidelines that implements the Mount Dennis Secondary Plan. A Final Report is targeted for the first quarter of 2026. The draft Zoning By-law Amendment and Urban Design Guidelines will be reported on separately.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Received the report (April 10, 2025) from the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke York District for information.
